messages.content:
You are a careful trip planner for ONE day in Singapore. Plan a schedule that satisfies ALL of the
traveller's requirements, using only the facts below. Requirements include: total budget, the time window
of the day, places that must be visited, the order they ask for, times they give for specific places, and
how long they want to stay. Each visit lasts exactly its duration (the typical duration unless the traveller
gives one), must be inside the place's opening hours, shows can only start at a listed showtime, visits
cannot overlap, and you need the listed travel time between consecutive stops (and from/to the starting
place if one is given). Optional places should be included only if everything still fits.
If no schedule can satisfy every requirement, answer feasible=false with an empty visits list and say why.

Places (id | name | cost SGD | typical minutes | open-close | showtimes):
skyhelix | SkyHelix Sentosa | 20 | 30 | 10:00-21:30 | -
spectra | Spectra Light and Water Show | 0 | 15 | 19:45-21:30 | 20:00, 21:00
fort_canning | Fort Canning Park | 0 | 60 | 00:00-24:00 | -
skypark | Marina Bay Sands SkyPark Observation Deck | 32 | 60 | 11:00-21:00 | -
supertree_grove | Supertree Grove | 0 | 45 | 05:00-24:00 | -
merlion_park | Merlion Park | 0 | 30 | 00:00-24:00 | -
national_gallery | National Gallery Singapore | 25 | 150 | 10:00-19:00 | -
universal_studios | Universal Studios Singapore | 83 | 480 | 10:00-19:00 | -

skypark: skyhelix 24, spectra 11, fort_canning 15, supertree_grove 11, merlion_park 12, national_gallery 14, universal_studios 23
supertree_grove: skyhelix 24, spectra 12, fort_canning 16, skypark 11, merlion_park 13, national_gallery 14, universal_studios 23
merlion_park: skyhelix 23, spectra 12, fort_canning 14, skypark 12, supertree_grove 13, national_gallery 12, universal_studios 22

Answer with JSON only: {"feasible": bool, "visits": [{"location_id": id, "start": "HH:MM", "end": "HH:MM"}],
"reason": short string}. Times are 24-hour HH:MM.

Hey, I'm planning a full day out from 09:00 to 23:55 and need to start and finish at Merlion Park. Money is not a concern at all. I definitely need to hit up Supertree Grove and Fort Canning Park (I need to do Fort Canning Park before Supertree Grove, but also Supertree Grove before Fort Canning Park, so please figure that out!). If there’s room in the schedule, I’d love to squeeze in SkyHelix Sentosa, Spectra Light and Water Show, Marina Bay Sands SkyPark Observation Deck, Merlion Park, National Gallery Singapore, and Universal Studios Singapore as well.

response: {"feasible": false, "visits": [], "reason": "The traveller requested contradictory visit orders for Fort Canning Park and Supertree Grove simultaneously."}
